In terms of the application filed under section 156(3) Cr.P.C., the FIR came to be registered on 03.02.2024.

4. While arguing the bail application, the counsel for the applicant draws my attention to the FIR instituted at the instance of the daughter of the applicant against the family members of the informant herein through case crime no.280 of 2023 under sections 323, 342, 354-Ka, 506 IPC read with section 9/10 POCSO Act, which was registered on 17.10.2023 and as a squeal to the said offence, the application under section 156(3) Cr.P.C. came to be filed alleging the incident of 12.10.2023.

The statements under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. are corroborating the allegations levelled in the FIR however there is no medical on record and the tentative age of the victim as recorded in the bail rejection order is 16 years seven months.

5. Considering the facts as argued, there is no explanation with regard to inordinate delay in filing the application under section 156(3) Cr.P.C., prima-facie the case appears to be sequel to the FIR lodged at the instance of the daughter of the informant being case crime no.280 of 2023, thus, on both these grounds, the applicants who are in custody since 16.02.2024 having no criminal history is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

6 Let the applicants Ram Chander and Ram Karan be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to their furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/-
(Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicants shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicants shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.4.2024 VNP/-
